history.summary: Compact 431-452sqft 1BRs at ~$960K ($2,124-2,246 psf) in a well-connected but chronically flat development. Yield ~3.2-3.5% is acceptable, but City Gate's own URA track record (+2.05%/yr over 5yrs, -2.2% last 12 months) shows this is a stagnant asset, and shoebox 1BRs in an investor-heavy strata-mall block are commodity product with no scarcity.
history.rating_rationale: Asking $2,124-2,246 psf vs recent 6-month transacted average of ~$2,096 psf — at or slightly above market. 84 URA resale transactions give high confidence in the weak 2.05%/yr CAGR, which badly lags the CCR baseline (~4.5%). Quantum is liquid (<$1M) and rentability is genuine (Bugis/CBD-fringe tenant pool, ~$2,500-2,800/mo), but there is no appreciation engine: a decade of near-flat prices despite a prime-fringe location.
red_flags: City Gate 5-yr CAGR just +2.05%/yr with NEGATIVE 1-yr momentum (-2.2%) on 84 transactions — chronic underperformer
Struggling 188-unit strata retail podium below (50% sold at launch; strata malls in SG chronically suffer vacancies) drags the residential premium
Investor-heavy unit mix (shoebox 1BRs + dual keys) means shallow owner-occupier resale pool
Mid-tier developer (Fragrance Group / World Class Land-Aspial) known for compact-unit products, not premium builds
Golden Mile/Aurea construction next door through ~2029 — noise and dust during the hold period
catalysts: Aurea at Golden Mile launched Mar 2025 at avg $3,005 psf — a ~43% pricing anchor above City Gate's ~$2,100 psf
Beach Road / Ophir-Rochor corridor rejuvenation: The Golden Mile mixed-use, Guoco Midtown, Kampong Bugis waterfront
Excellent connectivity: Nicoll Highway MRT (CCL) ~320m via link bridge, Bugis interchange (EWL/DTL) ~5-10 min walk

agent_evaluation.appreciation_assessment: URA data (84 resale txns) shows +2.05%/yr over 5 years with -2.2% in the last 12 months; recent transacted ~$2,096 psf (6mo). The rejuvenation story may lift this toward ~2.5-3%/yr, but Aurea's tepid launch (23/78 units) shows buyer resistance to premium pricing in this micro-market. Do not underwrite more than ~2.5%/yr.
agent_evaluation.stack_notes: East/SE stacks get Kallang Basin water views — target floor 15+ to clear Nicoll Highway traffic noise; note the new 45-storey Aurea tower (NE, ~250m away) may clip some northeast water views. North/West stacks have permanently unblocked low-rise Kampong Glam conservation views but take afternoon sun (west) and are nearest the adjacent Hajjah Fatimah Mosque (azan audible on low floors). Avoid floors 4-8 just above the 3-storey retail podium — road + podium noise.
agent_evaluation.appreciation_rate_source: URA 5-yr CAGR 2.05%/yr (84 resale txns, district fetch 2026-06-04) + modest uplift for Beach Road rejuvenation

history.summary: The widest band: compact 560-570sqft 2BRs from $1.25M ($2,193 psf) up to 807sqft dual-keys at $1.88M ($2,330 psf). Dual-keys rent strongly (two doors, $4,300-4,700/mo) but exit to a niche investor-only buyer pool. The headline asks of $2,389-2,394 psf run ~14% above the recent transacted average — negotiate hard or pass.
history.rating_rationale: Recent 6-month transacted average is ~$2,096 psf; several 2BR asks sit $2,250-2,394 psf. Paying the ask locks in years of the development's own ~2%/yr appreciation just to break even on the premium. The compact 570sqft 2BR at $1.25M ($2,193 psf) is the best relative value on the sheet and the only non-dual-key-style entry with broad resale appeal at a liquid quantum. Rental economics are fine (~3.2-3.5% gross on DKs); the appreciation engine is not.

Deep tenant pool from Bugis/CBD professionals. Compact 2BRs (~$3,300-3,600/mo) are easier single-tenancy lets.
agent_evaluation.appreciation_assessment: Same development-level reality: +2.05%/yr 5-yr CAGR, -2.2% last year, ~$2,096 psf recent transacted. The gap to Aurea ($3,005 psf) offers a plausible re-rating path, but Aurea's slow sales suggest it will pull slowly. Underwrite ~2.5%/yr; anything more is speculation.
agent_evaluation.stack_notes: Target the compact 570sqft 2BR at $1.25M ($2,193 psf) or negotiate DKs toward $2,100 psf. Prefer floor 15+ east/SE (Kallang Basin views, above traffic noise); the 45-storey Aurea tower may clip NE views. West-facing takes equatorial afternoon sun; low floors (4-8) sit just above the retail podium and Beach Road/Jalan Sultan traffic. Mosque adjacent — azan audible on lower north/west floors.
agent_evaluation.appreciation_rate_source: URA 5-yr CAGR 2.05%/yr (84 resale txns, district fetch 2026-06-04) + modest uplift for Beach Road rejuvenation

history.summary: Single 915sqft 3BR dual-key at $2.0M ($2,186 psf) — the most fairly priced listing relative to recent transactions and the largest non-penthouse format. Liquid quantum, ~3.2% yield, but it is still a dual-key in a flat development: rentability is good, the exit buyer pool is not.
history.rating_rationale: At $2,186 psf it sits closest to the ~$2,096 recent transacted average (~4% premium) — the most negotiable-to-fair pricing on the sheet, and $2.0M is within the liquid sweet spot. But 915sqft for a '3BR' is compact-investor product, the development's 5-yr CAGR is +2.05%/yr with negative momentum, and a dual-key 3BR resells to investors only. Fair price for a mediocre asset is still a mediocre asset.

Check whether the 45-storey Aurea tower will stand in its view line.
